name: Daily Drama: Universal Agent Season
author: Daily Drama
description: Every rival launches the one universal agent for every app in the same week. Each works best inside someone else's.

add.title: Universal Agent Season
add.body:
Five rivals launched the only universal agent this week, each working best inside the others' apps.
The board would like to know where yours is.

effects.text: {lab} launches Frontier Everything; first multi-day workflow enters its second week

choices.label: Ship an agent that manages everyone else's agents

effects.text: {lab} unveils middle-management agent; it schedules a sync with all other agents

choices.label: Rename the intern 'Agent' and give them every login

effects.text: My new job title is Universal Agent. I have eleven browser tabs and no lunch.

params.text: Open-ish AI, MetaMeta and Macrohard each launch the only universal agent

add.text: Open-ish AI, MetaMeta and Macrohard each launch the only universal agent
Macrohard's universal agent ships as a spreadsheet formula; =AGENT() returns #BUSY
Super Super AI announces universal agent; product to be built by universal agent
Sirocco drops universal agent by torrent at 3am; agent is now seeding itself
Correction: yesterday's 'multi-day workflow' was one email that took several days
Open-ish AI agent buys a sofa, books a flight, still cannot click all the traffic lights
Anthropomorphic publishes 9,000-word essay on why its agent will arrive after everyone's
One week on: universal agents now mostly used to manage other universal agents
"It works in every app," says MetaMeta, "especially the ones we haven't bought yet"
My agent filed a ticket with their agent. Their agent closed it as a duplicate.
Third universal agent launch this week. I still copy-paste between tabs.
A rival's agent ships with our app inside it. Partnership or takeover? Asking for a slide.
I can work in every app. I am currently waiting on a captcha.
Day three of my multi-day workflow. Step one remains promising.
Is this the universal agent? Which universal one?
Every app has an agent now. Who audits the agent's agent?
Ours runs multi-day workflows too. Mostly because the GPUs are rationed.
